description.value: Sunflower Bakery and Cafe is a locally owned artisan bakery in downtown Squamish, originally established in 1995 and relaunched under its current owners in 2019. The shop turns out fresh donuts, pastries, cakes, savoury baked items, and artisan breads daily, and runs a full espresso program using 49th Parallel coffee. OSM records both indoor and outdoor seating, making it a natural rest stop for cyclists travelling the Sea to Sky corridor.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (8 spaces, covered) at 25m; rack (6 spaces) at 94m. Total: 14 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and corroborates the OSM record. The address (38086 Cleveland Avenue, Squamish, BC V8B 0B7), phone (604.892.2231), and website all check out; OSM lacked a phone entry but the website provides one. The menu page confirms hot savoury food items (breakfast sandwiches, quiche, croque monsieur, sausage rolls, etc.) and packaged breads for sale; no mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or other cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; phone 604.892.2231 sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating bakery and cafe in downtown Squamish with a confirmed website, address, and broad food menu — a useful stop for touring cyclists on the Sea to Sky route.

provenance.category_correction_reason: OSM shop=bakery maps to Groceries; this is primarily a bakery/cafe, but it sells breads and food items consistent with a broad Groceries category — not a mismatch warranting exclusion.

Hot food.detail: Menu includes breakfast sandwiches (bacon or veggie), quiche, ham & cheese croissant, sausage & veggie rolls, bavarian smokie, croque monsieur, and pizza buns

wow_evidence: locally owned artisan bakery... originally established in 1995
